probes.heading: Probes
probes.guidance: Check service routes with scheduled HTTP requests. Destination access and capacity are controlled by your administrator.

probes.jsonHelp: Example: [{"path":["status"],"operator":"equals","value":"ok"}]. Paths are arrays of property names or array indices. Operators: equals, gte, lte.
probes.secretHelp: Use the ID of a stored HTTP authorization credential. Never paste a password or token here. Authenticated requests require HTTPS.
probes.writeWarning: POST probes create synthetic data. Use a safe test marker and an endpoint that supports the selected idempotency header. Do not put credentials in the request body.

sources.heading: Sources
sources.guidance: Manage incoming alerts. Automatic paging also requires an enabled policy binding for the service and environment.
sources.error: The operation could not be completed. Refresh before retrying; a failed response may have committed.

sources.manualHelp: This provider does not establish recovery. Silence does not resolve an incident.
sources.audit: Source configuration and grant changes are recorded in the host audit log. Disabling a source does not resolve an existing incident.
sources.grantHelp: Issue a short-lived grant and configure the provider using the host's documented ingress route. Rotate by issuing a replacement before revoking the old grant. Values are not saved to browser storage.
sources.receiver: Receiver reference (requires a valid provider signature)

detection.heading: Automatic paging
detection.help: Choose a reviewed escalation policy for this service and environment. This setting applies to all of their signal sources. Configure policies and coverage under On-call settings first.
detection.error: Unable to load or save automatic paging. Refresh before retrying. Activation requires a usable policy and delivery configuration.
detection.audit: Changes are versioned and audited. Disabling automatic paging does not resolve existing incidents or cancel their escalation.

heartbeats.heading: Heartbeats
heartbeats.guidance: Detect a missing periodic signal. Create the monitor disabled, provision its token and sender, choose an automatic paging policy, then enable it.
heartbeats.audit: Configuration and grant changes are audited. Disabling monitoring does not resolve an existing incident.
heartbeats.statusHelp: An absent missed-deadline record does not prove current health. Compare the stored deadline and last accepted time, and monitor the application's readiness separately.
heartbeats.grantHelp: Issue a token while the monitor is disabled, configure the sender using the documented heartbeat route, then enable monitoring. Expiry is checked by the server; an incorrect browser clock can cause rejection. Rotate by issuing a replacement before revoking the old token.

metrics.heading: Metrics
metrics.guidance: Monitor a sustained error-rate floor using paired request and error counts. Start disabled, configure the provider and paging policy, then enable sampling.
metrics.queryHelp: Each query must return one aggregate count series for the sampling interval, not a rate or cumulative counter. Use the same interval and scope for requests and errors.
metrics.floorHelp: The floor must be greater than 0 and at most 100%. The window must be a multiple of the sampling interval and contain enough samples. Missing or unusable samples never establish recovery.
metrics.audit: Configuration changes are versioned and audited. Disabling sampling does not resolve an existing incident.
metrics.historyHelp: History is ordered by receipt time, newest first, with record ID as the tie-breaker. Compare observed and received times; a recorded result does not prove current health.

reasons.floor_met: Every required bucket meets the floor
reasons.below_floor: At least one usable bucket is below the floor

retention.heading: Retention and coverage
retention.guidance: Manage replay history. The budget covers replay payloads, not total database disk use; protected operational records may exceed it.
retention.error: Could not load coverage or settings. Check the window (up to 31 days) and retry; maintenance may be busy.
retention.coverageGuidance: Gaps describe available evidence, not service uptime. The evidence cutoff controls which late arrivals can be included.
retention.saveError: Could not save. Refresh to check for concurrent changes or deployment limits, then retry.
retention.truncated: The query reached its limit. Coverage is incomplete; choose a smaller window.
retention.noExpectation: No expected sampling slots are known for this window. This does not establish health.
retention.noContinuity: Event intake does not establish continuous monitoring coverage.

deployments.guidance: Inspect release outcomes, watch evidence and coverage decisions.

deployments.emptyHistory: No releases recorded for this target.
deployments.watchGuidance: Deployment success does not mean the health watch passed.
deployments.noBaseline: No baseline capture is available. Missing evidence is not healthy evidence.
deployments.noWatch: No persisted watch is available yet. This is not a passing verdict.
deployments.notFinal: Still observing or awaiting final evidence
deployments.incomplete: Evidence inventory or query is incomplete.
deployments.overlapWarning: Overlapping releases make attribution uncertain; correlation is not proof of cause.
deployments.trackingOnly: Tracking-only start: no coverage proof was linked.
deployments.proofUnavailable: The linked coverage proof is unavailable; do not assume coverage was present.
deployments.historicalProof: This is the recorded proof for the accepted start, not a current authorization.
deployments.noOverride: No override was recorded on this proof.
